answer: Mechanism: operator-metered execution leases. Each wallet runs inside an operator’s shared kernel, and capacity is allocated per operator, not per wallet; sybil wallets multiplex one quota. Fraud triggers a wander audit of the operator’s lease history, revokes all its slots, and imposes a glacier cooldown plus retroactive compute debt on the operator. Cost: an attacker must provision many independent operators and absorb lost capacity and revenue, not just spin wallets.
